thread:
maya: heads-up: APAC GPU pool onboarding failing. multiple nodes erroring on keystore handshake + kubelet shows KMS decrypt failures. billing spike for NATGW shown. anyone?
kevin: saw similar in staging after we turned on deep-sni inspection + bumped audit sampling. SNI breakage caused many short-lived TLS sessions -> conntrack pressure.
jordan: paste kubelet snippet?
maya: 
```
E0324 02:11:05 kubelet.go:221] keystore decrypt failed: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection reset by peer
... tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: bad certificate
```
lia: ops-bot alert: conntrack privnet-ngw-1 90k -> 560k in 18m. NAT ports exhausted -> NATGW scaled out. Estimated extra cost: $110/hr. :grimacing:
ops-bot: ALERT conntrack_count(privnet-ngw-1) > 500k. natgw surge auto-scaling triggered.
kevin: likely root cause: new egress fw deep-sni rule breaking TLS reuse for keystore proxy + audit exporter fanout increase. more outbound sockets -> conntrack blowup.
jordan: do we route keystore via NATGW or privatelink here?
maya: APAC doesn't have privatelink for keystore yet — it's NATGW. Privatelink needs infra work + security review. Short term: either disable deep-sni for keystore or whitelist the keystore IP in egress path.
lia: security-bot: whitelisting host requires JIRA and compliance rationale; audit retention/regulatory note.
security-bot: note: any bypass of inspection must include compensating controls and be preserved in change log.
kevin: quick mitigations: 1) temporary SG: allow outbound 443 to keystore-proxy.apac.internal (10.240.5.12) from kubelet subnets; 2) disable deep-sni for that host; 3) conntrack bump on NATs: nf_conntrack_max=800k; 4) throttle audit exporter (batch_size=50, max_concurrency=4).
jordan: +1. also add a 6h TTL to that SG and record justification.
maya: commands I will run: 
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0f1a2b3c --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.240.0.0/18 --description "temp: keystore egress allow, TTL=6h"
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=800000
```
lia: please create the change doc with reason and link to JIRA. tag security owner @lia.
kevin: also add runbook snippet to ticket so on-call can triage: check SNI rules, conntrack, route (privatelink vs natgw), KMS role assumes, exporter fanout.
maya: applying SG + conntrack now in the 10:40z window. will report back.
ops-bot: NOTE: maintenance window 10:40z-11:10z for APAC mitigation.
maya: mitigation applied. conntrack dropped to 68k, most nodes joined. One node still failing handshake (timeout) — investigating.
jordan: owners: I will pick up privatelink task. creating infra ticket with estimate ~3d (infra + sec review).
kevin: add cost impact: NATGW extra usage last 24h = $2.1k. include in ticket.
lia: filing the compliance note now and recording temporary exemptions.
maya: follow-ups: keep temp SG for 6h, throttle audit exporter, open privatelink ticket, postmortem in #incidents.
kevin: runbook snippet posted in ticket: 
```
if keystore handshake errors:
  - check egress deep-sni rules
  - verify route to keystore (privatelink vs natgw)
  - inspect conntrack on NAT instances; increase nf_conntrack_max if urgent
  - throttle audit exporter to reduce outbound fanout
  - create temp SG allow with TTL and document justification
```
jordan: leaving :eyes: reaction. closing this thread unless new errors crop up.
